dateline: Mexico City — ARIRANG Tour Night 1 Draws 60,000+ Fans at GNP Seguros; Profeco Fines Ticketmaster Over Ticket Chaos
heroHeadline: Day 4,712: BTS Night 1 Success in Mexico City — 60,000+ Fans at GNP Seguros; Profeco Initiates Ticketmaster Fine
heroSubtitle: May 8, 2026 is Day 4,712 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS delivered a landmark Night 1 at Estadio GNP Seguros on May 7 before 60,000+ fans — the group's first Mexico City concert since 2019. The show ran ~8:15–10:20 PM local time with fire, pyrotechnics, and surprise songs 'Boy in Luv' and 'So What.' Night 2 is tomorrow (May 9), with Night 3 on May 10. However, the concert was overshadowed by controversy: videos of alleged empty reseller seats went viral while fans were stranded outside, prompting Mexico's consumer protection agency Profeco to initiate fine proceedings of 5M+ pesos (~$277,800 USD) against Ticketmaster México. South Korean prosecutors also rejected for a second time a police arrest warrant against HYBE Chairman Bang Si-hyuk, citing insufficient investigation. 'SWIM' remains on the Billboard Hot 100 in its sixth consecutive week. ARIRANG World Tour rolls on to Las Vegas (May 23–28, Allegiant Stadium) after the CDMX leg closes.
